stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 58%/18%, Mr. Action Jackson 79%/41%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 86% / 53%, The Mahomies 33% / 5.1%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 66% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 43%).
🏟️ Game to watch: GB @ LAR (Wednesday 8 PM), 1 league starters in action with 17.05 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Wednesday 8 PM (GB @ LAR): Golden for The Mahomies.
🏈 6 matchups are still up for grabs, and Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies (The Mahomies 59%) is the tightest.
🎲 Claremont In Yo Stace! is rolling with 2 kickers and 3 TEs (LaPorta, Andrews and Strange). It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
🔥 Brock You Like a Hurricane has won 6 straight. TDsMaGee gets the next crack at them.
🪑 LONG-TERM REGRET: TDsMaGee has yet to start Kirk Cousins. Starting him in Weeks 8 and 10 would have meant 1 more win by now (+18.60 pts).
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
